name: QuantumSong
description: QuantumSong is a Copenhagen-based research accelerator developing ruggedized laser-pumped optically-pumped magnetometer (OPM) cells and gradiometers for geophysical applications. Established as the joint R&D arm of Canadian magnetometer manufacturers GEM Systems (land/airborne) and Marine Magnetics (marine), QuantumSong applies quantum-optical sensing technology with research lineage from the Niels Bohr Institute Quantop group to industrial-grade magnetometers for air, land, marine, and VLF surveying.
funding: Subsidiary of GEM Systems and Marine Magnetics (Canada)
accessModel: B2B component supplier (OPM cells and gradiometers)
